messages.text: I saved two clean boxes from the parts delivery. Good cardboard for your little house walls.
Can we make the roof open so I can put the thermometer inside?
Yes. Hinge it with tape first, then test. Your mom said she can print the chart after the phones slow down at Desert Bloom.
Okay. I want to try the foil side and the paper side.
Mija, put the green socks and blue shorts in the hamper before school. I need one full load tonight.
Ok. The black pair by the door still hurts my toes.
We'll check size 3 after pickup. I also have to look at the polos and khaki bottoms from the school list.
Can I get the soft blue polo if it's not too much?
Mija, before teeth, can you look at the blue page for tomorrow?
I put a star by math and a pink dot by library.
Good. Backpack zipped too? I saw one cleat in the hallway.
Both are next to the front rug now. I added a tiny box for allowance Friday.
Did you save the yogurt lids from lunch? Ms. Park said flat pieces are easiest to tape on the little cardboard house.
Yes and I washed them with only a splash in the sink. I also have shiny chip bag pieces.
I found a cool vinegar volcano clip for our STEM notes. Can I send it here?
Yes here is good. I have to show Mom before I tap the next one after it.
Are you still doing the volcano slide tomorrow? I only have 2 cue cards.
We can put one house by the sunny bench and one under the tree, then write the numbers before STEM club ends.
Ok just watch the first one. It has the baking soda numbers written big.
Yes. I made a tiny checklist and drew the lava monster so my hands stop picking at my pencil.
Good because the bench near the swings gets burning hot after lunch.
Timer is only 15 minutes before dinner, so I will write fast.
Bring the drawing. Also don't make the pencil point disappear before science again lol.
I put one pencil in my backpack and hid the sharpener in the kitchen drawer.
Did the little fan make your cardboard house cooler or just blow the roof off?
Both kind of. I moved it next to the blue baseplate so the towers would not fall.
Can you bring the thermometer numbers tomorrow? I want to compare yours with my foil window.
Yes, but Mom says I have to clear the big table before dinner this time.
Mija, after homework can you help me find the little frame with Tio Mateo's picture?
Mija, I saved the recipe card by the stove. Read the first two lines to me before dinner?
Mija, ven cuando termines tarea. Esta carta de la escuela tiene palabras chiquitas.
Mija, pon los vasos en la mesa. The pan is hot and the paella needs five more minutes.
The gold one from the hallway box?
Ok Abuela. I can do the words and set the blue plates too.
Ya voy abuela. I read the top part in class today so I know that one.
Can I have a bowl of the rainbow cereal while I wait? Just a small one.
Small. Then bring the lime from the fridge for the cucumber slices, por favor.
Gracias. Despacio, para que yo lo escriba en la libreta.
Si. I want it by the candle while we play his old songs softly.
Gracias. After we eat, I will show you the old song your tio liked.
Ok. It says bring the blue form Friday and mom signs the bottom.
Can I put the orange flowers there too if Mom buys them?
Can I put it in my school folder? I want it for the table thing.
Ok I put the napkins too. The rice smells good.
Ms. Kim said our table has to pick one class helper tomorrow. Are you making a sign?
Maybe. I can do the poster but I can't do the grown-up paper thing like my mom does.
That math quiz face you made was scary lol. Did the pencil book help after?
Coach said bring both jerseys tomorrow. Also you still going to room 18 after school Friday?
Yes. I gave the tiny robot cape girl bigger boots.
Yes but only if my mom can wait after pickup. I don't want to miss the passing drill.
Same. My mom said we just choose who makes fair rules for line games.
I know. I still want the helper to let everyone use the good markers.
Show Lucia too. She always fixes the hair better than us.
You picked the busy version lol. Field, room 18, then your Thursday music-step thing.
She said tonight we can make a villain page together on video.
I know. My planner has arrows everywhere now.
Mija, I put your cleats by the door and washed the blue socks.
Can I do my 50 touches before we leave? I already changed after PE.
Yes, but water first. Pickup is 5:05 so we are not late to Riverdale.
Okay. I packed the extra hair tie too.
How was lunch today? Did you finish the bean tostada I packed?
Yes. A kid made a face at Diego's soup so I said it smelled good and sat by him.
Good choice. If the same kid keeps bothering him, tell Ms. Ramirez before it gets bigger.
I will. He also copied Diego's words weird, so I said that's how his grandma says it.
Mija, put the soccer socks in the washer when you get home. I need them clean before I look at the Rovers envelope.
The envelope from Coach has the spring team shirt thing and the game snack list.
Okay. Leave it by my purse, not in your backpack. Your dad and I will look at it after dinner.
Can I use my tooth fairy money for the blue hair ties?
For the mini-house, are you using the hot window side or the patio side?
Patio side. It gets the pink sky behind the roofs and the mountains look tiny from there.
Good test spot. Also my mom said the festival booths by the school might have cardboard pieces.
I can ask after pickup. We pass the park first anyway.
Did your mom say yes to the Tobin Heath backheel one? I want to try it Saturday.
She said one more after homework. I picked that and the corner-kick save.
Ok send me the move name tomorrow. Also you still owe me the drawing of our goalie dragon.
I drew wings during the song with the sisters because it is stuck in my head again.
Mija, put the folded paper from Dr. Moreno in your blue folder. The office needs it before lunch.
Okay. My arm still feels weird when I lift my backpack.
Use the other strap today and tell Nurse Kelly if it bothers you at recess. She knows what Dr. Moreno wrote.
I will ask her after announcements if it still hurts.
Mija, did the helmet fit okay for the visitor today?
Yes. He showed the strap trick and said look left right left even if cars are stopped.
Good. Anything else from class circle?
We talked about not calling people names and letting someone finish before you decide they did something wrong.
The orange cat still slides off the screen when I press the green flag.
Try changing x by 10 instead of 100. Also put the bounce block under it.
It worked! Can we add the plant cups as the background tomorrow?
Yes, and we can show the tall one and the short one with arrows.
Mija, put your folder on the table before snack so we can see what Ms. Vega sent.
I have the spelling list and the group volcano page. I need to color the parts.
After that, help me with napkins for dinner. Your coins for the book fair are still in the blue cup.
Okay, I will do the volcano page first and then napkins.
Mija, before you run outside, can you move the soccer bag away from the kitchen door?
Yes Abuela. I put it by the couch and Mateo's cars are in the basket.
Gracias. I saved soup for after practice, and the little yellow mug is ready if your voice sounds scratchy again.
Can I sit with you when I get back? Yesterday at school was weird.
That field was so dusty today. My socks are gray lol
My nose is doing the itchy thing again. Mom said wait till she checks the little bottle at home.
Tell her Coach made us do too many corner kicks. Did your ankle feel okay on the turns?
Mostly okay. I did the slow stretch Dad showed me before we left.
My dad said we can get there at 12:10. Bring the purple shin guards?
Yes. Coach R said I should try the wall pass again if I get nervous.
Do it with me first. If the first kick is weird we just fix it on the next one.
Deal. After, I need to tell Mia if computer time is open Monday.
I saved two clean cardboard tubes from the shop. Want them for your little roof thing?
Yes please. I need one side to be hot and one side to be less hot, then I can write the numbers.
Use the same lamp time for both sides. Same test, better answer.
After soccer I want to try the fan drawing too. If it works, people waiting outside would not melt so much.
The little blue bricks are hiding under the table again.
I know. I have to move them before Mateo comes for the pirate chapter.
Good plan. Clear a path and save one gear piece for the roof fan idea.
I put the tiny ones in the red cup and left the book on the couch.
For our Scratch background, should I draw the big blue room with the dinosaur bones or the coral part first?
Bones first! I added 3 dollars to my New York envelope after lunch.
Then I can make a button that switches to Rome columns after the bones room.
Yes, and another button for fish and coral when the sprite swims.
Mija, after church we come straight home. I made beans and rice already.
Can I bring the library book in the car?
Si, and your little bag has naranja slices. Leave the birthday card money on my dresser so your mama sees it.
Okay. I want it to go with the other folded bills.
Mija, put five plates before your papa gets home. The blue cup is for Mateo.
Ok Abuela. Mom said she is almost here from the clinic.
Gracias. Leave the extra plate in the cabinet tonight; Lucia is back at her tia's.
Did you ask if we can use the fan for the mini-house test? Ms. Kim said our board needs a real question by Friday.
I asked my dad. He said we can test cardboard roofs after I get back from the field tomorrow.
Your week is packed. Thursday is still the late shoe-bag night too?
Yes. I have to put the black shoes in my backpack before school or I forget.
Did Nurse Kelly say you can still do the cardboard fan test at STEM club?
Yes, she said just drink water and no wild goalie dives today.
My cousin said he saw a video saying school papers are silly. My mom said ask the office.
I asked my mom and Dr. Moreno already, so I am just bringing the paper tomorrow.
I found your old preschool folder in the garage. Same little cactus sticker on the North 5th address.
Can I use it for my poster? It has the tiny handprint page.
Yes. Keep it flat. After dinner we can glue it next to the map corner and the park photo.
The one where the sky is orange over the swings?
I found the old thermometer from the garage. It still works if we tape it inside the shoebox.
Can we test the cereal box wall, the egg carton wall, and the silver snack wrapper wall?
Yep. Same size pieces, same time in the patio sun. That makes the numbers fair.
I want the one that stays lowest to be like the bus stop idea too.
Backpack is by the door. I packed carrots and the little ranch cup for after STEM.
Can the pizza have extra cheese tonight if I finish the carrots?
We can do that. Eat the snack first so you are not starving before dinner.
Ok but save me the corner slice if Dad cuts it.
Mom can you pick me up at the front gate today? I don't want to talk in the car with everyone.
Yes, mija. Just you and me. Bring your water bottle and we will go straight home.
Also my throat feels scratchy again but not bad.
Okay. We will start with warm tea and soup. If it changes tonight, I will call the office in the morning.
Can you set aside the little bowl for Abuela's rice pudding? She wants to make it the way your great-grandma liked.
Okay. Is she going to tell the story about the blue kitchen again?
Probably. Put the playlist low so everyone can hear her.
The quiet one from Sunday?
Ms. Patel said we can use the two laptops if we sign in before 4:30.
I want to fix the sprite that slides through the wall. Maybe the x change is too big.
Try smaller numbers and test each one. Like your dad says when a try gives info.
Did your roof flap work or did it fall again?
Okay. I will write down which number works, then show you after pickup.
It stayed after Dad made me add two little braces like he does when something shakes.
That is smart. My mom said your mom waved from the clinic counter when we picked up my brother.
She was there late. She gave me three sticky labels for our test cups.
Mija, your mamá put the small box on the high shelf, not in your backpack.
Okay Abuela. My nose feels scratchy from recess but I can wait.
I have the towel and cold thing ready if your foot is tired after practice.
Gracias. Coach said we are doing light passing first.
Mija, your hand was shaking after practice. I put chocolate on the table.
Gracias Abuela. I am making the dragon goalie mad instead.
Bueno. Lucia called and asked if the dragon can have braids like last time.
Yes, and she gets to pick the shin guards.
Mija, after dinner we practice the two plant sentences in Spanish.
Can I say the water part in English first? Then Spanish for abuela words.
Si. Hold the cup picture up high and speak slow.
I want to say why the window cup got taller.
Are you bringing the little papel flowers tomorrow or the picture?
Both if they fit. My mom said the form has to match what we wrote last year.
My mom says grown-up forms are too picky lol. Also save me a seat by your table.
Ok. I still need to fix one label because it looked unfair that Mia's group got more space.
Are you bringing the shiny new black ones today or the old muddy ones?
Maybe new. Mom said only if I keep the box clean until the game.
Lol careful. My mom made me try on pants for school before practice too.
Same. I had to stand still for polos first. See you at the field.
Are you bringing the blue socks tomorrow or white?
Blue. I put a yellow sticky on my closet so I don't grab wrong ones.
Lol your sticky notes are everywhere. Did you draw more boxes for the art markers?
Only two more boxes left before I can ask at Target.
At recess I heard the silly voice again by the water fountain.
Tomorrow we can stand near Mateo when he talks. If they keep doing it, Ms. Kim needs to know.
Ok. Also your poster about turning the tap off looked better with blue marker.
Thanks. I still need the Spanish word from Abuela so I don't spell it wrong.
Did you finish the desert animal paragraph? I only have the drawing.
Almost. My mom said finish planner stuff before cleats.
Same. We still have to bring the shoebox tomorrow for our table.
I found one after dishes. I wrote my name inside so nobody takes it.
Coach said your through-pass was good yesterday. I almost caught it lol
I messed up two turns in the middle but I practiced in the yard today.
Same. Are you going Saturday or is your mom checking the time?
She said maybe 9:30 at Riverdale if it does not change.
My Scratch cat still walks backward when it touches the cone.
Check if your x number is minus instead of plus. I did that on my goalie game.
Can we add the little helper bot after the cone part works?
Yes. It can roll to the shade spot and say agua or water depending which button you click.
Did you get the new gel pens for our creature drawings?
Not yet. Mom said use the old markers and the library printer first.
Okay I can share purple. Are you still bringing pretzels to STEM club?
Yes. Also I put my Friday dollar in the pig before I forgot.
At the park thing tomorrow my mom said stay by the churro line if we get split up.
My mom said find the people in the blue shirts by the cones because they helped a lost little kid last year.
Also if the big kids shove again we tell Coach, not shove back.
My cousin put our passing drill on her story. The one where you almost scored.
Can you send me a picture here? I can't open that kind by myself.
Yeah. Same rules for them too, even if they act like they are in charge.
I will screenshot it. My mom says it disappears tomorrow anyway.
Thanks. Dad said after homework I can watch two soccer clips if he starts them.
Can your tiny field have bleachers for our team colors?
Yes but it is on my room table now because the kitchen has sopa stuff.
Put a snack stand too. My minifig needs nachos after scoring.
I made the roof pop off so I can check if the inside gets hot with the lamp.
When I get home we can copy that little gear trick from the brick car build.
Can we also do the bottle rocket one? Mom said kitchen table only and goggles.
Deal. Save one short goal reel for halftime, then parts go back in the blue bin.
Only if I get to play My Shot while sorting the wheels.
Little engineer, the sink guy wants the photo again. Can you ask Abuela not to run water there until I get home?
Okay. The paper he left says $400 if the part is cracked.
I saw it. Put the paper on the counter for me and Mom. Don't worry about that part.
I only have my seven dollars and coins anyway.
Can you test the Scratch button after lunch?
Maybe after Carlos moves the table. Lucia and Mateo are using it for cards right now.
Ok. Is your grandma making the cinnamon chocolate again?
Yes, and Elena said everyone has to clear stuff before Sunday breakfast.
Mija, I found coins in the laundry. Are these for your museum sobre?
Yes please put them with the New York one, not the soccer snack money.
Bueno. After breakfast you can show me the page with Rome again.
And the reef page with the tiny bright fish. I put sticky stars on those three pages.
Mija, Elena asked if you want tres leches or chocolate for August 14.
Chocolate with the blue frosting. And not the baby candles.
Claro. This time the cake needs two number candles.
The 1 and 0 ones, but I still don't get the grown-up forms at the rec center.
Mija, the plates can go by the sink when you finish that page.
Okay. The clue part is almost done and Mateo wants to hear it too.
Then lights low, por favor. Also check the tank lid before bed.
I did the lid and the plates. One more page only.
Game in 40 min. You got quiet at warmups so I saved you the blue ball.
Thanks. I'm going to do 5 kicks at the fence and then talk to my mom.
Ok. No pencil to murder on the field, so use the ball.
I kicked it hard and feel less buzzy now.
My mom heard your abuela say muy buen pase after the game lol
She asked me how to say pass before we got there 😄
At school you should tell Coach that one too
Maybe. In class I always forget and use the other words.
I found a clean cardboard piece for your cup display. Want me to cut two window slots?
I heard your table asked a big question after school.
Mia said if someone gets taken away, maybe their family can't bring homework or pajamas.
Yes please. Mia said our computer part can show the cat watering the taller cup.
That is a hard thing to picture. Did that happen to someone in our family or your close friends?
Good. Real cup on the board, moving part on the screen. That will make sense.
No. We were just asking because of the library book and because kids were guessing stuff.
I need room for my English words and my Spanish words too.
Mija, put your cleats and black shoes by the door before school tomorrow. I work until 5:30 today.
Okay. Do I still go to room 18 before the studio?
Yes, but only stay until 5:15. The teacher wants your notebook, and the studio starts later now.
I'll write it in my planner so I don't mix up the bags.
Angelita, dejé tu bolsa junto a la lavadora. The long socks are still damp.
Gracias Abuela. I need them for tomorrow.
Your mamá also put the new white shirts on the chair. No markers near them, por favor.
Ok I won't draw there. I'll use my notebook.
Angelita, your mochila is on the chair. Do you need the red paper from the kitchen?
Yes please abuela. It has the three things for morning.
I put it on top. Your shoes for futbol are beside the door, not where I walk.
Gracias. I also moved the little bar page so it doesn't get bent.
I put the signed school paper in the front pocket. Same two answers as before, so do not fold it.
I won't. Can I ask Mrs. Martin if Abuela's story can count for my paragraph?
Yes, ask politely. Finish your math first, then write it neatly.
Ok. I want it right because she helped me say the hard part.
Please remind Abuela the library paper is for 5:00 today, not tomorrow.
I told her antes de mi cereal. She put it by the fridge.
Good. And at school, use your full sentence for Mrs. Kim's reading answer.
I will. Abuela said my teacher words sound fancy.
Mija, I am still at Desert Bloom. The waiting room got busy, so Dad will get you after STEM.
Can he bring the little screwdriver? Our cardboard fan holder is wobbly.
I asked him. He said look at where it wiggles first, then tighten only that part.
Okay. I will mark it with pencil.
Mija, teacher said the group talk moved to Monday. Want your note cards after dinner?
Yes please. I already made boxes in my planner. Can I read first and then build the LEGO roof part?
Good plan. I also put two sharpened pencils by the backpack, no extra sharpener tonight.
Ok. If I get too quiet can you sit by me for the first card?
Our Scratch cat keeps walking through the wall again.
I need 5 minutes with my notebook first. My head feels too loud.
Ok. Make the helmet kid from your Lucia pages maybe?
Done. She made him a moon backpack yesterday. Now I can look at the blocks.
For Scratch, should the mayor sprite make school rules or city rules?
City rules. The kids can click choices but only the big people in the game count for the final button.
What colors for the two teams?
Use green and orange. I don't want the real grown-up team colors because I am not on either one.
Mija, I put the little box on your desk. The bracelet card says Sunrise and Las Vegas on it.
Thank you Abuela. Mom said not to bend it because it is very old.
Yes, gentle hands. After school we can sit by the front window and read before the church fish dinner.
If the sunset turns pink again I want to take a picture first.
Mija, for the class table I packed the little pan dulce. Put the card beside it so children know the name.
Can you check my accent mark? I don't want anyone saying it wrong.
Bring it to me. And take your reusable cup for the park cleanup tomorrow morning.
Ok. If someone laughs at Tomas's food again I'm sitting by his group.
The swings had sticky juice all over again. Coach made us put our bags on the wall.
I saw wrappers by the little kid slide too. I put two in the trash before Mom came.
Also no tree spot for waiting parents today. My water got warm so fast.
I might use that in my board picture with the thermometer numbers.
I fixed the loose leg on the small table. Good for Abuela's pictures now.
Thanks Dad. The flowers kept falling when I bumped it.
No more wobble. Also saved the choir track you asked for in the car.
Can we play it before Sofia's game so I don't feel jumpy?
Mija, leave me the red connector pieces and the tape. I can help make the launch tower straighter after lunch.
Game ended early. Want me to bring anything before we go home?
Smoothies please. And if there are churros can we get some for everyone?
They are by the small table with the straw rocket and the silver paper.
Smoothies yes. Churros only if the line is short. Abuela already has the big pan started.
Good. Keep the first try too, so we can see what changed.
Tell her I will set forks when we get there.
Okay. The city block is still on the other plate so nobody step on Main Street.
I saved the Cubs highlights and the mini fan experiment clip. Tablet stays on the counter.
Can we do the fan one after lunch? It might help the tiny house stay cooler.
Yes, 20 minutes. If another video pops up, call me before touching it.
Ok. I will only write down the parts list first.
I saw the sideline video. The kick went wide, but you still ran back in.
Coach Ramirez said not to hide after it. Sofia yelled my name so loud.
And then you found her open. That pass was clean.
I wrote what happened in my notebook so I can try a different angle next time.
My mom said your notebook at the game had arrows and numbers like a coach board lol
It was for passes first, then I used the same page for the bus stop roof idea.
You always turn practice into an experiment.
Because if the angle is wrong, the ball and the shade both go the wrong way.
Did you find the safe lava lamp one? My mom said no fire ones.
Yes, Elena checked it. It uses oil and food color. I saved it after the Lego elevator.
Nice. Put the fast soccer saves after? We can copy the diving motion for our sprite.
Ok, but I also put Satisfied because the rewind part is good for timing.
Angelita, close the patio door, por favor. Your mamá said the cool air is for inside.
I closed it. The hallway machine is on again because it was hot after practice.
Gracias. Put your cleats by the door too, so your papá sees the broken lace.
He said not to use my snack money for that.
Mom said Nurse Kelly sent one more note home. Put it by the LEGO truck so I see it when I get back.
It says Dr. Moreno checked the date and it is all good now.
Good. Grown-up paperwork is like fixing a loose bolt: right person, right tool, then done.
I put it with Mom's clinic folder, not in my soccer bag this time.
Angel, before we leave, check backpack: planner signed, multiplication sheet, and the reading folder.
I have them. Can I use the five dollars from my birthday card for the fair?
Yes, put it in the zipper pocket. After pickup, we will look at the group poster parts before practice.
Okay. I still need to ask Mia which picture goes on the top.
After the windy practice, rinse your face and leave the orange cap bottle on my dresser, okay?
Okay. I only used the tissue. My ankle is not sore, just dirty cleats.
Good. I will decide if you need the small dose before bed. Put the ice sleeve back in the freezer.
Done. Cleats by the door too.
I fixed the little air needle. Your backyard ball should not go flat again.
Thanks Dad. I need it for touches tomorrow because we did hard running in PE today.
Good. After Wednesday field nights, check the laces before Saturday. Tools and shoes both fail when you ignore tiny parts.
I will. My right cleat knot came loose last time.
I am by the office. Do you have the ribbon, the cups photo, and your laptop login card?
Yes. Ms. H said our table got picked first for the room walk.
Good job. Put everything in the blue folder before we leave.
I said the last part in Spanish and nobody laughed.
I'm stopping by Big 5 after the shop. Need anything for tomorrow's bag besides laces?
The little rubber things came off one shoe. Mom said ask you.
Got it. Also text me your size for the navy pants before Elena checks out online.
Size 8 maybe but the waist was weird.
I saved two small boxes for your cooling model. Want to test vents after dinner?
Can we do fast? Coach added extra sprints and my legs are tired.
Fast test, good notes. Then I drive you to the 7:05 place so Mom can finish work.
Thank you. I packed the notebook and the shoes this morning.
Lamp off after this chapter, okay? Tomorrow is early.
Okay. I already found Mateo's dinosaur shirt and his folder.
Gracias. Please put your project table cups away before you climb in bed.
Done. The book is under my pillow but the lamp is off.
Are you still coming on Scratch after dinner or is your grandma making the yellow rice thing again?
After. She said I have to help with plates first. I asked for cereal but Mom gave me cucumbers with lime.
lol bring some to school tomorrow if you get extra.
Maybe the lime ones. Not the rice because everyone eats it fast.
I put cardboard in the garage for your school suggestion box model. Need tape?
I found cardboard tubes at the shop for your mini-house fan idea.
Yes. I made slots for clinic forms, playground trash, and kids getting called the wrong name.
Good because the LEGO lights can wait, right?
Three slots, good engineering. Labels big enough for everyone to read?
Right. We build with what we have tonight. Abuela has dinner warm, and I put trail mix in your game bag.
I have two allowance dollars for the pig after dinner.
I made English and Spanish cards. Sofia said add one for lunches too.
I saw the hallway was clear when I came in. Nice teamwork with Mateo.
Mom said to keep the little cars out of the way before Abuela comes from the kitchen.
Good plan. Your mom is finishing the dishes, then she said you two can talk on the porch.
Okay. Can Abuela make the chocolate later if Mom says it's fine?
Heard tomorrow is penalty shots. Want to set up the cardboard target in the driveway?
Yes. My stomach is doing the fast thing. I drew three tiny goalies in the margins.
Margins are fine. After 10 kicks, we sort the LEGO pieces for the mini-house fan.
Deal. I only sharpened one pencil this time.
Please put your cleats by the door before I get home. Your dad is using the garage side.
Ok. Mateo left blocks near Abuela's chair so I moved them.
Thank you. Lucia might come after dinner Saturday, so keep the pink blanket clean.
I will. Should I leave my backpack in our room or the hallway?
Mija, Mia's mom sent the Hamilton clip to me. Finish reading first, then I can sit with you.
Can I see just that one? Sofia also said her team picture is on a page.
One song clip, then dinner. For the team picture, ask her to text it here or I will open it for you.
Ok, I asked her for the picture here.
Your Scratch game music sounded different from mine. Was that from your grandma?
For our comic, should the kid with the sign say 'listen first' or 'be fair'?
Can your abuela come see our Scratch game Monday?
Yes, she hummed it and Dad helped me record. I only used 10 seconds so it is fair.
Maybe both but not too many words. My mom says grownups should ask questions before grabbing someone's backpack.
Maybe. I have to tell her what the sign-up page says first.
You always do the paper parts fast.
The kitchen level with the recipe clues was cool. My sprite got stuck by the pot.
Only little ones. I like when she says claro mija after.
Did that happen to your cousin or somebody?
I fixed that after STEM. I want the ending to show the family table before the timer stops.
No, nobody close. I just remember the blue-shirt helpers at the festival and the helmet talk at school.
Mija, I saved the clean carton from the eggs. It is on the counter for your little house.
Thank you Abuela. I need one more wall piece before I put it outside tomorrow.
Use the bowl to rinse it, not the running faucet, okay?
Okay. I am also drawing the park bench with trash by it but making the cover bigger.
Mija, read me the Spanish page after dinner, then show me the little house with the shiny top.
Okay Abuela. I put the English words on one side and Spanish on the other so more people can use it.
Good. And do not leave the LEGO wheels where my knee finds them.
I moved them. The wheels are for the tiny cart that brings the cold cup under the roof.
